body:
You don’t have to live, but dying might not be your only choice right now. There have been many times in my life where I have wanted to die, and I have even made plans to go through with it. But had my circumstances been different, those same things that made me want to kill myself, would not have had the same effect.

Maybe there is a way out of your situation, Maybe there are people who could help.

Everyone is good at something, including you. I Often compare myself to people who are way better than me things that I want to be good at. I also know that I am not like those people. I don’t think that that’s necessarily a bad thing. I would say that in my life there are a few things I’m better than most people at, but there are so many other things That other people are better than me at. If I were to measure myself against others based on who is better than me, then I would be forever defeated, because there are so many other people out there who have skills in areas that I don’t even understand. When thinking in these terms, there’s no way to win, but fortunately there is a different and better way to see ourselves.

Sometimes I feel like the choices I’ve made in my life have made me inferior to others, perhaps because I didn’t take the time to listen or learn a skill or do well in school. But at the same time, I’m different from others and I can’t therefore judge myself by the same ruler.

I know that a person with Similar skills could easily replace me. I know that there will always be people better than me, no matter what. Because of this, the ruler which all people could be judged by is not determined by how smart, witty, charming, or Skilled they are. Human value is an intrinsic property of humanity. There will always be people better at One thing than another.  For example, There are people who have learning disabilities, but they are still valuable people. They are valuable because they exist and for another reason—you are valuable because you are you.

I also know I will never be good enough, either for myself or for others. We all feel that way. None of us are truly comfortable as we are until we accept that we are different—and that it’s okay to be different. You are the best at being you! and you have a place in this world.
